stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: May is Peter's aunt. After Uncle Ben's death she falls ill, and Peter takes a job at the Daily Bugle to pay for her medicine, then smashes the Kingpin's fake drug ring that made it. She fusses over him when he has a cold.
stages.whoA: His Aunt May, whose medicine he works to pay for.
stages.whoB: Her nephew Peter, whom she fusses over.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson hires Peter as a Daily Bugle photographer while waging a crusade against Spider-Man. Spider-Man still rescues him again and again, once making him say please first.
stages.whoA: His boss at the Bugle, who hates Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Peter, his photographer. Spider-Man, his favorite target.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter meets Betty Brant, Jameson's secretary, when he joins the Daily Bugle. Spider-Man saves her from Doctor Octopus, Parafino and a shadow tiger, and she helps him escape Henry Smythe's robot.
stages.whoA: Betty, Jameson's secretary and a friend at the Bugle.
stages.whoB: Peter, a friend at the Bugle. Spider-Man, her rescuer.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Mary Jane invites Peter to her debut as a go-go dancer at a Times Square club. The club is a front for the Kingpin's mind control plot, and Spider-Man saves her and the city officials.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, a friend who invites him to her debut.
stages.whoB: Peter, a friend she invites to her debut.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Captain Ned Stacy rescues the injured Spider-Man from a mob, and Spider-Man saves him from a prison breakout. Later Stacy resists the Radiation Specialist's mind control and helps Spider-Man beat him.
stages.whoA: Captain Stacy, a police captain who trusts him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a hero he stands up for.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man first chases the young flyer Skyboy, then learns he is Jan, son of the kidnapped Dr. Caldwell, and helps him rescue his father from Dr. Zapp.
stages.whoA: Skyboy, a boy he helps rescue his father.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who helps him save his father.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus plans to blow up part of New York from a hidden lab and traps Spider-Man and Betty there. Spider-Man stops him, and again when he steals the Nullifier.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, his nemesis.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Green Goblin dabbles in witchcraft to summon demons, using Jameson as his medium. Spider-Man tracks him to a graveyard and stops him, and again after Dr. Noah Boddy frees him.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, a villain who dabbles in witchcraft.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Testing a swamp fever serum on himself, Dr. Connors becomes the Lizard. Spider-Man cures him at an old Spanish fort and later saves him from an alligator his work made intelligent.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, the Lizard, whom he cures and rescues.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who cures and rescues him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Vulture turns birds on New York for a ransom and steals a military rocket, and Spider-Man beats him each time.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, a winged thief.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero who keeps catching him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Electro frames Spider-Man for his robberies, and Spider-Man catches him at an amusement park and again after each escape.
stages.whoA: Electro, who frames him for robberies.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Mysterio frames Spider-Man for a robbery and offers to trap him for Jameson, until Spider-Man records his confession. He returns with tricks and illusions, and Spider-Man beats him each time.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, a master of illusions who frames him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he frames and fools.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Scorpion is made to catch Spider-Man for Jameson, then turns on Jameson. Spider-Man webs him up, and catches him again after two prison breaks.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, a mutated man he keeps jailing.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he was made to catch.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Sandman steals the Goliath Diamond and frames Spider-Man, who beats him by knocking him into a trough of water.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, a thief made of sand.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Rhino steals parts of a secret weapon, and Spider-Man catches him at his zoo hideout and again when he raids gold shipments.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, a horned brute.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Kingpin runs a fake medicine ring that harms Aunt May and kidnaps Jameson, and later hides a brainwashing scheme in a nightclub. Spider-Man shuts both down.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, whose fake medicine hurt Aunt May.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who shuts down his rackets.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The invisible Dr. Noah Boddy targets Jameson until Spider-Man webs him up. He then frees three villains to destroy Spider-Man, and all four end up in jail.
stages.whoA: Dr. Noah Boddy, an invisible villain.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Henry Smythe builds a Spider-Slayer robot to capture Spider-Man for Jameson, but Spider-Man breaks free of it.
stages.whoA: Henry Smythe, who builds a robot to catch him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the target of his robot.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino traps Spider-Man and Betty above hot wax to make him an exhibit, and later returns with wax robots. Spider-Man beats him both times.
stages.whoA: Parafino, a wax artist who wants him as an exhibit.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Master Technician lifts Manhattan into the sky for ransom until Spider-Man beats him. As the Radiation Specialist he does it again and controls the city's minds, and Spider-Man beats him with Captain Stacy's help.
stages.whoA: The Radiation Specialist, who lifts Manhattan twice.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: A master of disguise poses as a Prime Minister, then as Peter and Spider-Man, to steal money and art. Spider-Man catches him both times.
stages.whoA: A master of disguise who impersonates him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Miss Trubble conjures Greek monsters to punish Jameson, until Spider-Man smashes her box.
stages.whoA: Miss Trubble, who conjures monsters.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Snubbed by the Science Hall of Fame, Dr. Matto Magneto attacks with a magnetic gun, until Spider-Man's anti-magnetic webbing destroys it.
stages.whoA: Dr. Magneto, a scientist out for revenge.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who wrecks his magnetic gun.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Fiddler fires sound waves from his violin to ransom an impresario, until Spider-Man captures him.
stages.whoA: The Fiddler, a villain with a sonic violin.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Plotter sends Cowboy and Ox to steal missile blueprints, but Spider-Man lures them into a trap and nabs the gang.
stages.whoA: The Plotter, a criminal mastermind.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Dumpty robs an actress and a gala with balloon gadgets, and Spider-Man captures him.
stages.whoA: Dr. Dumpty, a balloon-loving jewel thief.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man comes face to face with Infinata, a skeletal menace from the fifth dimension.
stages.whoA: Infinata, a menace from the fifth dimension.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Twins Stan and Lee Patterson steal as the Human Fly and later frame Spider-Man, who catches them both times.
stages.whoA: The Human Flies, twin thieves.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Fakir steals jewels with illusions and charmed crocodiles, until Spider-Man takes his flute.
stages.whoA: The Fakir, a thief with a magic flute.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Phantom shrinks loot with a ray and sets robot henchwomen on Spider-Man, who beats them all at his base.
stages.whoA: The Phantom, a thief with a shrinking ray.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who beats him and his robots.
